usage: The word '劏房' is a noun that refers to a small separate living unit created by subdividing a larger flat.
It is commonly used to describe low-cost, cramped housing conditions in Hong Kong.
'劏房' can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
When talking about renting or living conditions, '劏房' often appears with verbs like '住' (live) or '租' (rent).
It can be combined with numbers or adjectives to specify the size or condition of the subdivided flat.
